summary: Ryde Group Ltd, a Singapore-based NYSE American-listed issuer, filed a Form 6-K updating holders on two legal matters ahead of its September 29, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. A shareholder petition in the Grand Court of the Cayman Islands seeks, as principal relief, an order requiring purchase of the petitioner's remaining shares at fair value, alternatively winding up the company. No liquidator has been appointed and directors retain control. Separately, a putative SDNY securities class action covers purchasers from March 6 to September 11, 2024, with a November 9, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline. No price, stake or premium terms were disclosed. Watch whether the Cayman fair-value claim escalates toward liquidation or a buyout.
